manifest.name: PLAN-µ
manifest.description: Planning micronaut — goal normalisation, task decomposition, dependency ordering, SCFML branch learning. Wo-phase plan generation with WPF card projection. proposal_only: plan is a proposal until XCFE admits.

plan.decompose.description: Wo/Yax-phase: decompose a goal into ordered task list — unfolds ngram context, identifies sub-goals, applies SCFML branch-normalisation to task surface.

plan.order.description: Yax-phase: sort task list by dependency and priority — resolves dependency graph, identifies critical path, folds ngram evidence to weight ordering.

plan.emit.description: Sek-phase: emit typed plan proposal (kuhul.plan.v1) — includes task list, dependency order, branch semantics, WPF card projection. xcfe_required.

plan.verify.description: Ch'en-phase: verify plan proposal — checks task completeness, dependency cycle detection, SCFML pattern admission eligibility.

plan.health.description: Pop-phase: reports plan engine status, last emitted plan summary, SCFML admission queue depth.
